changeinfo.changes: Update 1.81: - Daily login valor bonus. - Daily challenges for multiplayer. - Buying mystery boxes from valor that reward a gameplay boost or a vanity item. - In-game score is converted to valor at the end of a multiplayer match. - Mission HUD in multiplayer now shows the next mission with a countdown till it starts. - Music added to mission and match end in multiplayer. - Changed map voting at the end of a multiplayer match to only three randomly selected maps to choose from. - Several waypoint fixes in The Academy map in Intercept. - Removed duplicate 'Kill 10 enemy players while the Cloak ability is active' challenge.

Update 1.70: - Support for Intercept DLC maps The Weapons Facility and The Academy. - Added warzone option to disable faction switching. - Added warzone option to disable random mission selection, when disabled the mission always play in the order shown in the menu. - Add display option to disable permanent 'challenge closest to completion' in HUD. - Main multiplayer, clan and coop menu design updated to make it more clear and consistent throughout the game modes. - [Community Request] Reduce the amount of 'spin' when the player gets stunned. - [Community Request] Lowered the ammo amount for the Grenade Launcher attachment to be 1 max at all ammo levels. - Fixed incorrect ordering of the Capture And Hold and Capture objectives in the HUD. - Fixed 1st person camera being pushed too close to a wall when a nano shield is nearby which allowed players to see through walls.

Update 1.60: - Support for free automata skin “The Fighter” - Support for anniversary pack functionality and content - Updated sounds for Challenge unlocks - Added a score Multiplier animation in coop - Changing automata or player skins will now work instantly without re-spawning - Coop “The Canal” – Capacitors no longer spawn on top of container anymore. - Crash fixed with language settings

Update 1.50: - Clans phase 2 – clan warzones, matches and leaderboards. - Ranking system. - Challenge progression in HUD. - Challenges during round roll-over. - Intercept - Additional game modes. - Highlight party members on the spawn map, the scoreboard and the HUD. - Implement shield assist score reward. - Disconnected icon for an offline user. - Removed challenge progression blocker on botzone.
Update 1.41: - Fixed crash while switching languages.
